stem:
Ritu shares the same chapati equally. She compares the unit fractions 1/6 and 1/8 from that whole.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: 1/8 is greater than 1/6 because 8 is greater than 6.
1/6 is greater than 1/8 because fewer equal shares make each share larger.
1/6 and 1/8 are equal because each numerator is 1.
1/8 is greater because the denominator is the size of the share.

teacher.key_rationale: For unit fractions of the same whole, more equal shares make each share smaller, so 1/6 > 1/8. Treating a larger denominator as a larger share reverses the relation; matching only the printed 1 captures a surface feature; calling the denominator the size of the share substitutes the wrong label.

mx_swap.reason: Multiple-count fractional-unit CWO invents a different hinge; kept relationship_reversal, surface_feature_capture, term_substitution on the unit-fraction size hinge.
